The '''New Imperial Guard''' was a group of elite [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] that served as the personal guard of [[Darth Malgus]], the [[Emperor/Legends|emperor]] of the [[New Empire]]. Led by the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Chondrus Berani]], the New Guard welcomed [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] into their ranks and wielded [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]] into battle while wearing their crimson and black armor. The New Guard fought to defend their master during the [[Battle of Ilum]] when an enemy strike force boarded the [[Emperor's Fortress]], but Berani and many Guardsmen were killed before the strike force reached the throne room. Malgus dismissed the Guard so that he could battle his opponents alone, and the New Empire collapsed with the destruction of the space station and Malgus' apparent death.<ref name="False Emperor" />
